_doc: Embargo Room is bridge-agnostic. A disclosure's source of truth is its portable, hash-chained record (record/*.record.json) plus its state files (downstream/state.json, the clock, the attestations) — NOT the chat platform. The chat app is a replaceable transport. If a bridge is down or overloaded, re-point the room to a healthy bridge and the disclosure continues from the same verified state. 'enabled' lets an operator take a bridge out of rotation; status.js picks the first enabled + reachable bridge in [primary, ...fallback]. See docs/bridges.md.

slack.note: Connected in Switch Console (Socket Mode). One app posts under each agent's name and icon.

mattermost.note: Bundled local server. A bot account per agent in the channel member list.
